title: Ganaxolone Reverses the Effect of Amyloid beta-Induced Neurotoxicity by Regulating the Liver X Receptor Expression in APP Transfected SH-SY5Y Cells and Murine Model of Alzheimer's Disease.
authors: Divya; Faruq, Mohammed; Nazir, Sheikh Sana; Kaushik, Pooja; Parvez, Suhel; Vohora, Divya
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨加奈索酮通过调控LXR受体缓解阿尔茨海默病中Aβ神经毒性，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inhibiting beta-amyloid aggregation and enhancing its clearance are the key strategies in Alzheimer's disease (AD) treatment. Liver X receptors (LXRs) plays a crucial role in cholesterol homeostasis and inflammation, and their activation can clear Abeta aggregates in AD. Allopregnanolone, a neurosteroid, positively influences AD through LXR regulation, while ganaxolone, its synthetic analog, is known for its neuroprotective properties. This study explores the effect of ganaxolone on LXR activation and regulation of genes involved in mitigating Abeta toxicity and tauopathy in SH-SY5Y cells transfected with APP695 Swe/Ind plasmid and an Abeta1-42 induced AD mouse model. Molecular docking stimulations indicated ganaxolone's binding and interaction with LXRbeta. Subsequently, transfected neuronal cells exhibited increased mRNA levels of APP, TNF-alpha and IL-1beta, decreased cell viability, reduced MMP and altered protein expression of Abeta, LXR, BCL-2, APOE, ABCA1, along with increased levels of mROS, Bax, and caspase 3 activity. Ganaxolone treatment significantly abrogated Abeta-induced effect in transfected neuronal cells by enhancing LXRbeta expression, inducing LXR:RXR colocalization, thereby increasing APOE and ABCA1 expression. It also decreased tau mRNA levels in transfected cells. Importantly, in AD mice, ganaxolone ameliorated cognitive impairment, reduced Abeta toxicity, tau levels, and neuroinflammatory markers, restored mitochondrial function, and decreased neuronal apoptosis. Taken together, these novel results highlight the central role of LXR in mediating Abeta-induced toxicity and provide preclinical evidence for ganaxolone as a potential agent to reduce toxicity in an LXR-dependent manner. This may serve as a promising treatment strategy to slow or prevent neurodegeneration in AD patients.
abstract_zh: 抑制β-淀粉样蛋白聚集并增强其清除是阿尔茨海默病（AD）治疗的关键策略。肝X受体（LXRs）在胆固醇稳态和炎症中发挥重要作用，其激活可清除AD中的Aβ聚集体。别孕烯醇酮作为一种神经甾体，通过LXR调节对AD产生积极影响，而加奈索酮作为其合成类似物，以神经保护特性著称。本研究探讨了加奈索酮对LXR激活及调控涉及减轻Aβ毒性和tau蛋白病变的基因的影响，研究对象为转染APP695 Swe/Ind质粒的SH-SY5Y细胞及Aβ1-42诱导的AD小鼠模型。分子对接模拟表明加奈索酮与LXRβ存在结合和相互作用。随后，转染神经元细胞表现出APP、TNF-α和IL-1β mRNA水平升高，细胞活力下降，线粒体膜电位（MMP）降低，以及Aβ、LXR、BCL-2、APOE、ABCA1蛋白表达改变，同时mROS、Bax水平和caspase 3活性增加。加奈索酮处理通过增强LXRβ表达、诱导LXR:RXR共定位，从而增加APOE和ABCA1表达，显著消除了转染神经元细胞中Aβ诱导的效应。它还降低了转染细胞中tau mRNA水平。重要的是，在AD小鼠中，加奈索酮改善了认知障碍，减少了Aβ毒性、tau水平和神经炎症标志物，恢复了线粒体功能，并减少了神经元凋亡。综合来看，这些新结果突显了LXR在介导Aβ诱导毒性中的核心作用，并为加奈索酮作为以LXR依赖性方式减轻毒性的潜在药物提供了临床前证据。这可能作为减缓或预防AD患者神经退行性变的 promising 治疗策略。
